tags:

logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        - Image|endswith: '\certoc.exe'
        - OriginalFileName: 'CertOC.exe'
    selection_cli:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '-GetCACAPS'
            - 'http'
    condition: all of selection*
